One of Zao's Tibia Tales. The old {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}, in the Souleater Mountains, asks you to find the last three wills of her family, lost in the ruined houses of the village. When you hand them over you discover the truth about her. You receive 50 experience points for each level you have and can obtain the addons of the {wiki:Wayfarer Outfits|Wayfarer Outfits}.
When you hand the three {item:Faded Last Will|Faded Last Wills} to the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)
